description: Spend against an open PabandiSession -- book a service, pay an invoice, or fund an escrow. REQUIRES a sessionId. Sessions are authorised once against a Trust-Score-derived limit and let you transact repeatedly without a wallet signature per call, which is the entire point. If you do not have a session, call pabandi_open_session first and use the sessionId it returns; this tool will refuse without one rather than fall back to a per-call signature. A booking action may return actionRequired 'deposit_required' plus a deposit object (amount, currency, checkoutUrl); fund the deposit at checkoutUrl before treating the booking as settled.

actionType.description: What kind of action this spend authorises

amount.description: Amount in USDC to deduct from the session limit

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the original receipt and does not spend again.

payload.description: Action-specific detail. For bookings this must include businessId, so the server can evaluate the business's deposit policy. Opaque to the engine otherwise; hashed into the receipt.

sessionId.description: id of an active PabandiSession (from pabandi_open_session)

name: pabandi_execute_transaction
